svg.title: Inclined ladder material lift — Hallandi efnislyfta
svg.desc: A shallow load tray rides on two inclined ladder-like rails extending upward from a ground base.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-inclined-material-lift","label_en":"Inclined ladder material lift","label_is":"Hallandi efnislyfta","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["lifting","material-lift"],"description":"A shallow load tray rides on two inclined ladder-like rails extending upward from a ground base.","design_note":"The sloping rails and moving tray show an inclined goods lift rather than a climbable access ladder.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
